source.paraphrase: process.binding is an undocumented internal entry point; application modules should use supported public APIs.

invariants.why: Internal bindings can change between Node releases without the compatibility guarantees of public modules.
invariants.fixHint: Import the documented Node module that exposes the needed capability.
invariants.avoid: Bracket access to binding is the same internal call.

source.paraphrase: An uncaughtException listener must perform emergency handling; an empty callback suppresses the default failure path.

invariants.why: An empty listener keeps a process alive in an undefined state after an uncaught exception.
invariants.fixHint: Report the failure and terminate cleanly, or omit the listener and let the runtime exit.
invariants.avoid: Changing quote style or using an empty function callback does not handle the error.

source.paraphrase: TLS clients verify peer certificates by default; setting rejectUnauthorized to false explicitly disables verification.

invariants.why: Without certificate verification an active intermediary can impersonate the server.
invariants.fixHint: Leave verification enabled and configure a trusted CA when necessary.
invariants.avoid: Other TLS options do not restore certificate verification.

source.paraphrase: Enabling shell routes command and arguments through a shell instead of executing the program directly.

invariants.why: The extra shell interpreter can treat data as commands when arguments are assembled from input.
invariants.fixHint: Invoke the program directly with an argument array.
invariants.avoid: Specifying a working directory does not make shell execution safe.

source.paraphrase: Underscored module loader hooks and require.extensions are internal or deprecated extension mechanisms.

invariants.why: Loader internals have unstable contracts and execute source outside the normal import path.
invariants.fixHint: Use import or a supported loader integration instead.
invariants.avoid: Using Module._compile or assigning require.extensions is still a loader modification.
